_comment: Serf-specific model metadata overlays. Merged on top of litellm_model_catalog.json at load time. These fields are not available upstream and must be maintained here. An entry absent from the LiteLLM base is materialized as a Serf-only catalog model when it carries context_window; max_output_tokens overlays/materializes the output cap. reasoning_effort_levels are wire-spelled (e.g. ["high","max"]): serf's ClampReasoningEffort raises below-range requests to the lowest supported level and resolves the top tier to the model's own spelling, so a wire-spelled list replaces any per-model thinking map.

glm-4.5-air._note: z.ai GLM stock model (Pi zai.models.ts). No effort param — thinking on/off only; keeps profile default ladder.

glm-4.7._note: z.ai GLM stock model (Pi zai.models.ts). No effort param — thinking on/off only.

glm-5-turbo._note: z.ai GLM stock model (Pi zai.models.ts). No effort param — thinking on/off only.

glm-5.1._note: z.ai GLM stock model (Pi zai.models.ts). No effort param — thinking on/off only.

glm-5.2._note: z.ai GLM stock model (Pi zai.models.ts). Effort param supported; Pi thinkingLevelMap {minimal:null,low/medium/high:high,xhigh:max} == wire-spelled levels [high,max] under serf's clamp.

glm-5v-turbo._note: z.ai GLM stock vision model (Pi zai.models.ts). No effort param — thinking on/off only.

deepseek-v4-flash._note: DeepSeek V4 stock model (Pi deepseek.models.ts). Effort param supported; wire-spelled levels [high,max].

deepseek-v4-pro._note: DeepSeek V4 stock model (Pi deepseek.models.ts). Effort param supported; wire-spelled levels [high,max].

kimi-for-coding._note: Serf-only entry — the Kimi coding plan's single model (K2.7 Code); not in the LiteLLM catalog. context_window present, so this materializes a catalog entry.
